title: coreopsis buchii
intro: Coreopsis buchii, commonly known as Pluchea buchii, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Coreopsis buchii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Coreopsis buchii include sesquiterpene lactones, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as inhibiting the growth of microorganisms and reducing inflammation.
